protocol: step5_temporal_purge_v2 (supplementary robustness — NOT a replacement for Step 4)

source_arrays.note: no re-inference; predictions bitwise identical to Step 2/4

purge_rule.sample_convention: PFV sample identified by issue week t (0-indexed weekly record); input history = 24 weekly steps [t-23, t] (predict_sliding_temporal uses X_full[t-23:t+1]); label = target at t+4; inclusion by prediction-year filter on year(t)
purge_rule.protected_boundary: b = first week index whose calendar year equals test_years[0]
purge_rule.rule: KEEP iff t - (H-1) >= b; REMOVE iff t - (H-1) < b
purge_rule.equivalent_form: in verification time v = t+4 the input history starts at v - (H-1) - lead = v - 27; keep iff v - 27 >= b
purge_rule.role_of_lead: lead=4 does not extend the input history backward; it enters the rule only through the PFV inclusion convention and the equivalent verification-time formulation

tau_selection: none — τ=0.90 pinned a priori, carried over from Step 4; never selected on the purged test set or on GBR
